rektion: jdn. (Akk.) zu + Dat. / nach + Dat. befragen (Passanten zu ihrer Meinung befragen)
meaning_en: to question, to survey, to interview (ask someone a series of questions)
definition_de: jemandem gezielt mehrere Fragen stellen, um Informationen oder Meinungen zu bekommen; auch von der Polizei (Zeugen befragen) oder in Umfragen (die Befragten)
example_de: Trotz des strömenden Regens befragte die Reporterin auf dem Marktplatz mehrere Passanten zu ihrer Meinung.
example_en: Despite the pouring rain, the reporter questioned several passers-by on the market square about their opinion.
visual_idea: Collocation 'Passanten befragen' (street survey): a reporter holds a microphone to one passer-by while others with umbrellas wait their turn. The queue of people shows a series of persons being asked (not a single 'fragen'), the microphone + camera make it clearly a Befragung, and the rain adds humor. Beat 'die Polizei befragt Zeugen' (uniforms attract text, notepad is small) and 'der Arzt befragt den Patienten' (reads as a normal consultation).
image_prompt: a young female reporter in a bright yellow raincoat holding a plain black handheld microphone toward a middle-aged man under a large umbrella who answers with a lively hand gesture, behind him three more passers-by with umbrellas wait in a short line, a cameraman with a shoulder camera seen from behind at the left edge, cobblestone market square of a German old town with half-timbered houses and plain storefronts, steady rain and shiny puddles, eye-level medium-wide shot
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels, logos
video_prompt: on a rainy cobblestone market square of a German old town, a young female reporter in a yellow raincoat holds a black microphone toward a man under an umbrella who answers and gestures, then she turns the microphone to the next passer-by in the short line; static camera, steady rain, puddles rippling
